title: Static vs dynamic dispatch
subtitle: Follow a call to notify() through the generated code
staticFacts: One copy of notify per concrete type, generated at compile time.
The call is a direct jump to a known address: LLVM can inline it.
&Email is a thin pointer: 8 bytes on 64-bit.
dynamicFacts: One copy of notify, shared by every type.
The call loads a function pointer from the vtable, then jumps: no inlining across it.
&dyn Notify is a fat pointer: 16 bytes (data + vtable).
